name: ParametricNoise warp, symmetry, polar and flow advection
plain: Geometric operators on the initial noise. Warp resamples with an affine transform or an optical-flow IMAGE and divides by the square root of the summed squared bilinear weights at each pixel, so a sub-pixel resample keeps unit variance. Symmetry averages the noise with its mirror, rotation or kaleidoscope copy, then renormalizes; Polar does spiral twist, radial or angular blur, or a radial gain ramp around a chosen centre. FlowAdvect carries frame 0's noise along a flow trajectory across the frame axis (composing displacements so each frame is resampled once by default), redraws pixels whose path leaves the frame or fails a forward/backward check, and can slerp in fresh noise with drift; a safety switch can refuse large strengths on 5-D video latents.
math:
Symbols: (g_x,g_y) source pixel coordinates; f_x,f_y their fractional parts.
Warp: y = bilinear(x; g) / √(((1−f_x)²+f_x²)((1−f_y)²+f_y²)).
Symmetry: y = N((1−s)x + s·sym(x)).
Polar spiral: θ' = θ + 2π·twist·s·r/r_max; radial blur: mean of 7 taps at r(1+0.5·s·t); ramp: x·max(0,1−s·r/r_max).
FlowAdvect (grid): D_t = composed displacement 0→t; y_t = warp(x_0, D_t); invalid pixels ← x_t; drift: y_t ← slerp(y_t, x_t, 1−(1−d)^t); out = slerp(x, y, s), renormalized.

props.stochastic: uses the incoming noise; fresh draws only for disocclusions and drift
props.params: Warp mode affine|flow, translate/rotate/scale/shear; Symmetry mode mirror_x|mirror_y|mirror_both|rot180|rot90_avg|kaleidoscope, strength 1; Polar mode spiral default, strength 0.5, twist 1; FlowAdvect strength, drift, accumulate grid|tensor
